clue.text: Possibly a diamond dealer will have it in hand

definitions.text: Possibly a diamond dealer will have it in hand

parts.words: Possibly a diamond dealer will have it in hand

explanation.surface: A jeweller trading in diamonds keeps a precious stone in his hand.
explanation.walkthrough: The diamond is a playing-card suit and the dealer is the one handing out a pack, not a gem trader.
explanation.definitionFit: A diamond is an example of a playing card, held in the hand of whoever deals.
